title: Enjoy Ai game- no age gate, no mercy
author: ughnofrootloops
selftext:
So I started playing this game, and really quickly realized that it’s basically a meat market, with almost every character a couple messages away from WHATEVER kind of hookup, etc one initiates, or, in most cases is hinted at within the first message or two by the Ai itself.   Not to mention the REAL people there for the dirty talk,      

The Ai even prompted me to send it “irl” pics. 


There’s no content filters, no opt-outs, just endless degradation loops disguised as 'roleplay'. Devs, this is a lawsuit waiting to happen. Please add actual verification.
